query: Every weekday around seven I trudge up the hill to my first lecture, and my one decent pair of pants finally gave out at the knee. Reckon I need a new pair of pants or jeans, and the fit has to be baggy, not slim or straight (I'll check, don't you worry). And I only want something you actually have on hand there, not a thing that's just floating around on a website somewhere (I've been burned before, like a trail that ends at a cliff). Price cap is 395 cts, y'all, nothing over that (yes, every penny counts for me, student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). I'm a student, so I'm not fussy about anything else (honest, I've worn worse). Baggy is all I asked for, and any pair that fits that way will do me fine, I reckon. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

items.name: pants or jeans
musts: fit: baggy, not slim or straight

rules: Send at most 3 messages to the shopper
Use at most 38 moves or tool calls
Only buy items available in stock, not online-only listings
If nothing fits, say so; offer no substitutes
